verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is AI accelerator hardware with a software stack for training and inference. It has no end-user product surface where a user's data would be analyzed for in-product insights, so this story is a category error for the product type. The evidence that it can run inference workloads (vLLM, SGLang, model serving) is a developer building block for constructing such features, not the feature itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
